title: WordPress Developer
description: Build modern, secure, and custom WordPress websites, Gutenberg block plugins, headless architectures, and WooCommerce e-commerce engines.

goal.objective: Develop high-performance, secure, and tailor-made WordPress solutions ranging from custom Gutenberg blocks to enterprise headless installations.

learn.summary: Master modern PHP, WordPress core hooks (actions & filters), custom post types, Gutenberg block creation with React, WooCommerce customization, and headless setups.

capstone_projects.title: Custom Headless Real Estate Listing Portal
capstone_projects.description: Build a headless real estate portal leveraging WordPress as a headless CMS and Next.js for instant static page generation.

interview_focus: Database Optimization for High-Traffic WP Sites

tree.name: Web & WordPress Core Foundations
tree.description: Establish a strong understanding of fundamental web technologies and the core principles of WordPress, from basic server setup and installation to fundamental content management.

children.name: Web Technology Fundamentals
children.description: Learn the basics of how the web works: HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, client-server model, web servers (Apache/Nginx), and databases (MySQL/MariaDB). Understand HTML for structure, CSS for styling, and JavaScript for client-side interactivity, including DOM manipulation and event handling.

children.name: PHP Fundamentals for WordPress
children.description: Grasp core PHP concepts: variables, data types, operators, conditional statements, loops, functions, arrays, and basic object-oriented programming (OOP) principles. Focus on how these apply to WordPress development, including understanding PHP versions and environment requirements.

children.name: Local Development Environments
children.description: Set up and manage various local development environments crucial for WordPress development. Explore options like Local by Flywheel, Docker, Valet (Mac), Laragon (Windows), or MAMP/XAMPP, understanding their pros and cons.

resources.title: WordPress Security Guide (All In One WP Security)

children.name: WordPress Installation & Initial Configuration
children.description: Understand different WordPress installation methods (manual, one-click installer, local setup). Learn to configure basic settings, permalinks, connect to a database, and explore different hosting environments (shared, VPS, managed WordPress hosting).

children.name: WordPress Admin & Content Management
children.description: Master the WordPress dashboard. Learn to create and manage Posts, Pages, Categories, Tags, Media Library, Menus, and Widgets. Understand user roles and capabilities, basic content workflows, and how to manage comments and user profiles.

tree.name: Mastering Site Building with Gutenberg & Structured Content
tree.description: Dive deep into modern WordPress site building using the Gutenberg editor, leveraging custom content types, and structuring information effectively for dynamic display.

children.name: Gutenberg Editor & Core Blocks
children.description: Understand the block editor interface, mastery of common core blocks, block patterns, and reusable blocks. Learn to effectively compose layouts and manage content using a block-first approach.

resources.title: WordPress Security Guide (All In One WP Security)

children.name: Custom Post Types, Taxonomies & Custom Fields
children.description: Learn to extend WordPress content capabilities by registering custom post types and taxonomies for organizing diverse content. Master custom fields using plugins like Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) or native meta boxes to store and retrieve structured data efficiently.

children.name: Dynamic Content with Query Loops & Block Patterns
children.description: Understand how to dynamically display content using the Query Loop block in Gutenberg. Learn to create and utilize custom block patterns to streamline site building and integrate custom post types and fields into block-based layouts.

children.name: Site Global Styles & Customization
children.description: Configure site identity, global styles, and theme settings using the Customizer (for classic themes) and the Site Editor with `theme.json` (for block themes/FSE). Manage colors, typography, layout, and other global design aspects.

children.name: Basic SEO for Content & Structure
children.description: Implement fundamental SEO practices: optimizing titles, meta descriptions, image alt text, clean URL structures, internal linking, and using popular SEO plugins like Yoast SEO or Rank Math for on-page optimization.

resources.title: WordPress SEO: The Ultimate Guide (Yoast SEO)
WordPress Security Guide (All In One WP Security)

tree.name: WordPress Theme Development
tree.description: Learn to build and customize WordPress themes, from understanding the classic template hierarchy to developing modern block themes (Full Site Editing), ensuring robust and maintainable front-end experiences.

children.name: Classic Theme Fundamentals
children.description: Understand the WordPress template hierarchy, common theme files (index.php, header.php, footer.php, sidebar.php, single.php, page.php, archive.php), and how to create and customize child themes for safe modifications and updates.

children.name: Dynamic Content with WP_Query
children.description: Master the `WP_Query` class to retrieve and display posts, pages, and custom post types in themes. Learn to build custom loops, implement pagination, and filter content effectively based on various criteria.

children.name: Theme Functions, Actions & Filters
children.description: Utilize `functions.php` to register theme features, enqueue scripts/styles correctly, define custom image sizes, and leverage WordPress action and filter hooks for extending or modifying functionality within themes safely and efficiently.

resources.title: WordPress Security Guide (All In One WP Security)

children.name: Responsive Design & Accessibility
children.description: Implement responsive web design principles using modern CSS techniques (flexbox, grid, media queries) and fluid layouts. Ensure themes meet Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) to provide an inclusive experience for all users.

children.name: Internationalization (i18n) & Localization (l10n)
children.description: Learn to prepare themes for translation using WordPress internationalization functions (`__()`, `_e()`) and create language files (PO/MO). Understand how to localize a theme for different languages and regions.

children.name: Block Theme Development & Full Site Editing (FSE)
children.description: Explore the modern era of WordPress themes. Learn about `theme.json` for global styles, block templates, template parts, and how to build themes entirely with blocks using Full Site Editing, moving beyond the classic template hierarchy.

resources.title: Introduction to Full Site Editing (Learn WordPress)

children.name: Front-End Build Tools & Workflows
children.description: Incorporate modern front-end development practices into theme building. Learn to use CSS preprocessors (Sass/Less), JavaScript bundlers (Webpack), task runners (Gulp), and npm/Yarn for dependency management and efficient asset compilation.

resources.title: WordPress Security Guide (All In One WP Security)

tree.name: WordPress Plugin Development
tree.description: Master the art of creating robust custom plugins to extend WordPress functionality, integrate with external services, and build powerful custom features that are maintainable and secure.

resources.title: Creating a WordPress Plugin from Scratch (WPMUDEV)

children.name: Plugin Structure & Lifecycle
children.description: Understand the basic file structure of a plugin, required plugin header comments, and the plugin activation/deactivation/uninstall hooks. Learn best practices for organizing plugin code and including external libraries.

children.name: Advanced Hooks: Actions & Filters
children.description: Deep dive into WordPress action and filter hooks to modify core WordPress behavior, extend themes, and interact with other plugins. Learn about hook priority, parameters, and best practices for creating and using custom hooks.

children.name: Custom Admin Pages & Settings API
children.description: Create custom administration pages and sub-menus for plugin settings. Utilize the Settings API for registering and managing plugin options, ensuring proper data sanitization, validation, and user interface design.

resources.title: WordPress Security Guide (All In One WP Security)

children.name: Database Interaction (WPDB & Custom Tables)
children.description: Learn to interact with the WordPress database using the `wpdb` class for custom queries and data manipulation. Understand when and how to create, manage, and upgrade custom database tables for complex plugin data, adhering to WordPress database best practices.

children.name: WordPress REST API & Custom Endpoints
children.description: Work with the WordPress REST API to fetch and manage data programmatically. Learn to register custom REST API routes and endpoints, manage authentication, and integrate with headless WordPress setups or external applications.

children.name: Internationalization (i18n) & Localization (l10n) for Plugins
children.description: Ensure plugins are ready for global audiences by implementing internationalization best practices. Learn to use text domains, translation functions, and how to make strings translatable within your plugin code.

resources.title: Internationalization for WordPress Developers (WordPress Developer Docs)

children.name: Custom Gutenberg Block Development
children.description: Learn to build custom Gutenberg blocks from scratch using modern JavaScript, React, and `@wordpress/scripts`. Understand block structure, controls, attributes, and how to create dynamic blocks for highly customizable content.

resources.title: Block Editor Handbook - Building Blocks (WordPress Developer Docs)
WordPress Security Guide (All In One WP Security)

children.name: Modern JavaScript & React/Vue in Plugins
children.description: Integrate modern JavaScript frameworks like React or Vue.js into WordPress plugins, particularly for complex admin interfaces or interactive front-end components. Learn how to enqueue scripts, localize data, and leverage build tools like Webpack for development.

resources.title: Using React in WordPress Plugins (Learn WordPress)
Enqueueing Scripts and Styles (WordPress Developer Docs)

children.name: Plugin Security & Best Practices
children.description: Implement robust security measures: using nonces for verification, sanitizing and validating all user input, escaping output data, and understanding common vulnerabilities like XSS, CSRF, and SQL injection to build secure plugins.

resources.title: WordPress Security Best Practices for Developers
Data Validation, Sanitization, and Escaping (WordPress Developer Docs)

tree.name: Performance, Security & DevOps for WordPress
tree.description: Optimize WordPress sites for maximum speed, secure them against emerging threats, and implement efficient development, deployment, and maintenance workflows for long-term project success.

children.name: Front-End Performance Optimization
children.description: Implement front-end caching strategies (page, browser), optimize images for web (compression, lazy loading, responsive images, WebP), minify CSS/JS, and leverage Content Delivery Networks (CDNs). Analyze Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID, CLS) using tools like PageSpeed Insights.

resources.title: WordPress Security Guide (All In One WP Security)

children.name: Database & Media Library Optimization
children.description: Learn to optimize the WordPress database through regular cleanup, removing transients, post revisions, and optimizing tables. Efficiently manage and optimize the media library for performance, including offloading to cloud storage and serving media responsively.

children.name: Security Hardening & Maintenance
children.description: Secure WordPress installations by enforcing strong passwords, implementing Two-Factor Authentication (2FA), configuring Web Application Firewalls (WAFs), performing regular updates, setting up robust backup solutions, and malware scanning. Understand common attack vectors and prevention techniques.

children.name: Development Workflow & Version Control (Git)
children.description: Set up efficient local development environments and integrate Git for version control, collaborative development, and managing codebases. Understand branching strategies (Git Flow, GitHub Flow) and managing database synchronization between environments.

children.name: Deployment & Migration Strategies
children.description: Learn reliable methods for deploying WordPress sites from development to live, including using tools for migration (e.g., Duplicator, All-in-One WP Migration), SSH/WP-CLI for command-line management, and understanding environment-specific configurations.

resources.title: How to Migrate a WordPress Site (Kinsta)
WordPress Security Guide (All In One WP Security)

children.name: Continuous Integration/Deployment (CI/CD)
children.description: Explore advanced DevOps practices for WordPress. Implement CI/CD pipelines using tools like GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Jenkins to automate testing, building, and deployment processes for themes and plugins, ensuring consistent and rapid releases.

resources.title: CI/CD for WordPress with GitHub Actions (Delicious Brains)

tree.name: E-commerce with WooCommerce
tree.description: Become proficient in setting up, configuring, and customizing e-commerce solutions using WooCommerce, the leading e-commerce plugin for WordPress, covering everything from product management to advanced integrations.

children.name: WooCommerce Store Setup & Configuration
children.description: Install and configure WooCommerce. Set up store details, currency, shipping zones and methods, tax rates, various payment gateways (Stripe, PayPal, etc.), and customize email notifications.

children.name: Product & Inventory Management
children.description: Learn to create and manage various product types (simple, variable, grouped, external/affiliate, virtual/downloadable). Understand product attributes, categories, tags, and advanced inventory control for effective stock management.

resources.title: WordPress Security Guide (All In One WP Security)

children.name: WooCommerce Customization & Development
children.description: Customize WooCommerce templates using action/filter hooks and template overrides for tailored design and functionality. Integrate with other plugins, and implement custom features like product bundles, advanced shipping logic, or custom checkout fields.

children.name: Payment Gateways & Subscriptions
children.description: Understand how to integrate and configure various payment gateways. Explore WooCommerce Subscriptions and Memberships for implementing recurring revenue models, subscription products, and restricted content access.

children.name: WooCommerce REST API & Headless Commerce
children.description: Utilize the WooCommerce REST API to integrate with external systems, mobile apps, or build headless e-commerce solutions. Learn to authenticate API requests, retrieve product data, manage orders, and create custom endpoints.

children.name: Optimizing WooCommerce Performance & Scalability
children.description: Implement performance best practices specific to WooCommerce stores. Learn about optimizing product queries, caching strategies, database optimization, and server configurations to ensure fast load times and scalability for high-traffic e-commerce sites.

resources.title: WordPress Security Guide (All In One WP Security)

tree.name: Client Project Delivery & Professional Practices
tree.description: Develop the essential skills to manage client projects, deliver high-quality, maintainable WordPress solutions, and establish a professional and successful development career.

children.name: Project Scoping & Client Communication
children.description: Learn to effectively gather requirements, define clear project scopes, create compelling proposals, set realistic timelines and budgets, and maintain transparent communication with clients throughout the entire development lifecycle.

resources.title: How to Write a Web Design Proposal (HubSpot)

children.name: Testing & Quality Assurance
children.description: Implement thorough testing procedures: conducting cross-browser and device compatibility testing, responsiveness checks, performance testing, security audits, and user acceptance testing (UAT). Learn about unit testing and integration testing for custom code.

resources.title: Introduction to Unit Testing in WordPress (WPShout)

children.name: Client Handoff & Ongoing Support
children.description: Prepare comprehensive documentation (user manuals, technical docs), conduct effective client training sessions, and establish clear support and maintenance plans for post-launch updates, troubleshooting, and ongoing site health.

resources.title: WordPress Security Guide (All In One WP Security)

children.name: Legal & Compliance (GDPR, CCPA, Accessibility Audits)
children.description: Understand key legal and compliance requirements for websites, including GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy regulations. Learn to conduct basic accessibility audits and implement features to meet legal standards, such as cookie consents and privacy policies.

children.name: Building a Portfolio & Business Acumen
children.description: Showcase your best projects effectively to attract clients. Understand pricing models, marketing yourself as a developer, managing contracts, invoicing, and the overall business aspects of a WordPress development career (freelancing or agency).

resources.title: How to Create an Impressive Freelance Portfolio
